afnd.citation: Gonzalez-Galarza et al., Allele frequency net database (AFND) 2020 update, Nucleic Acids Research 48:D783, doi:10.1093/nar/gkz1029
afnd.name: Allele Frequency Net Database (AFND)

terms.note: AFND publishes no standalone licence; under the owner-approved policy (#149) a completed check that finds no explicit restriction is no_restriction_found.

clinvar.name: ClinVar, National Center for Biotechnology Information

terms.note: ClinVar asks downstream users to attribute copied or distributed data to ClinVar.
GeneReviews content has noncommercial reproduction terms. This source file stores links as evidence locators and does not reproduce chapter content.

Project-authored data and outputs are CC BY 4.0 by the owner's decision D5a (2026-10-19; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-atlas-data-platform-design.md §1.1). Apache-2.0 covers source code and documentation.

map.citation: Piel et al., Global epidemiology of sickle haemoglobin in neonates, The Lancet 381:142 (2013); Howes et al., G6PD deficiency prevalence and estimates of affected populations in malaria endemic countries, PLoS Medicine 9:e1001339 (2012)
map.name: Malaria Atlas Project (MAP) HbS and G6PD survey databases

terms.note: MAP's open-access policy covers all its survey data, HbS and G6PD layers alike: the data are not owned by MAP, public survey data have no restrictions to access or use, and users are asked to cite the original sources. The owner approved open redistribution of the HbS survey rows on 2026-10-18 (the 2026-09-16 parity input).

worldpop.name: WorldPop gridded population (the surface target grid)

terms.note: WorldPop's hub states that WorldPop datasets are licensed under CC BY 4.0, recorded as explicitly_open by the owner's decision D5b (2026-10-19; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-18-atlas-data-platform-design.md §1.1). WorldPop selects the population-positive H3 cells a format-2 surface is predicted on.
